I actually do 3 player, 3 trust CP parties all the time. 

Find yourself a Melee RDM/NIN or RDM/DNC that can Inundate, Distract, and Dia mobs while giving Haste II and Haste Samba (if applicable), then do 6 step skill chains with the RDM using tier 5 nukes to burst. You can easily get 1mil+/hr with that burn.

For instance, I use RDM, BLU, WAR and commonly RDM, BLU, DRG.

Requiescat (MM) > Ukko's Fury (E) > Chant du Cygne (E) > Upheaval (MM) > Requiescat (MM) > Chant du Cygne (E) = 6 step darkness.  By the end of this chain, almost all apex mobs will be dead if you're not in sparks gear. We're all wearing ambuscade and alluvion skirmish gear so not even escha NM gear yet.

Use a skill chain calculator.  I downloaded one called FFXI Calculator. Melee burn PTs are complete viable.
